# EGYM & GrowthBook | Introduction & Demo
Date: 2026-10-28 | Duration: 78m

## Summary
GrowthBook was shortlisted for experimentation after multiple providers were reviewed following the merger, with A/B testing as the primary focus. The current gap is that the Wellpass team runs experiments across the app and frontend without A/B testing capability or sufficient measurement, creating a need for faster product learning. GrowthBook combines feature flags, experiments, and product analytics, supporting a workflow from feature development through performance measurement and impact analysis. Its warehouse-native approach uses Snowflake as the source of truth while retaining customer data ownership. The existing stack includes Snowflake, Hex, Mixpanel migration, and Fivetran pipelines for combining experiment metrics. Member attributes can support runtime eligibility, although cross-domain availability remains customer-owned. Member ID hashing can provide mobile and web consistency, while anonymous-to-member tracking, persistent anonymous identifiers, consent, and exposure confirmation require further design. A product demonstration is planned for next week, followed by POC scenario definition, requirements clarification, timeline confirmation, and EU hosting clarification. The target launch window is end-November to December.

## Keywords
Experimentation, Feature flags, Snowflake analytics, Anonymous identity, Warehouse-native analysis, Proof of concept

# EGYM & GrowthBook | POC discussion and next Steps
Date: 2026-11-26 | Duration: 28.850000381469727m

## Summary
The discussion established a four-week initial POC with two or three A/B tests, initially on one surface, while preparing five-to-ten experiment ideas to potentially accelerate progress. Support will include Europe-based coverage, commercial support from Marcel, technical help from Chris Dyson, time-zone coverage, SLA and response commitments, and experimentation enablement. Success criteria must define before-and-after states, measurable outcomes, and relevant experiments. Technical work progressed through React web, micro-frontend, feature-flag, and GrowthBook test-environment testing, with Snowflake setup underway, while sticky bucketing and the AI visual editor remain untested. Web and app testing was requested, but cross-surface and mobile ownership require coordination. Data planning includes curated Snowflake views, a dedicated schema, conversion and revenue metrics, and validation of anonymous-ID and account-ID stitching. Legal work remains open on cookie duration, AI training terms, contract details, and the cookie banner, which blocks the production POC. Next steps include expanding the Slack channel, completing organization and license setup, testing enterprise features, and reviewing the commercial proposal next week.

## Keywords
A/B testing, Experimentation platform, GrowthBook POC, Snowflake integration, Identity stitching, Cookie compliance
